text:
amelia: Heads-up — planning to enable 'strix-v2' in the model catalog tonight during the 22:00-23:00 UTC change window. Canary -> staged -> full.
deploy-bot: scheduled deployment for catalog.model_enable strix-v2 at 2026-04-02T22:00:00Z (canary: 5%). Release ID: rel_2026_04_strix_v2_01.
ryan: thanks. Canary 5% ok. Do we have fallback ordering defined if strix-v2 returns higher latency? Need deterministic variant priority.
sophia: yes — proposing fallback priority: [strix-v2-q8, strix-v2-q4, strix-v1-pt, default-llm]. Also plan to pin enterprise customers to strix-v1 for 24h after enable.
mike: +1 for pinning. Which users get pinning list? We should include customers with dedicated capacity and top 10 revenue.
amelia: correct — pin list is the dedicated contracts + 10 enterprise orgs in the commit. Nora is owner for the list. @nora can you confirm?
nora: confirmed. Uploading org list to the rollout PR now.
sophia: adding quick config snippet for the fallback map (will be part of catalog release notes):
```
fallbacks:
  - priority: 0
    model: strix-v2-q8
  - priority: 1
    model: strix-v2-q4
  - priority: 2
    model: strix-v1-pt
  - priority: 3
    model: default-llm
```
ryan: rollforward plan? If canary is healthy at 30m we move to staged 25% then 60% then 100% over 3 hours?
sophia: yeah schedule: 00:00-00:30 canary 5% -> health check; 00:30-01:00 staged 25%; 01:00-02:00 ramp to 60%; 02:00-03:00 finish 100% (all UTC).
julian: define rollback triggers now so SRE can watch: error rate > 1.5x baseline for 10m OR p95 latency increase > 30% OR NPS-eval regression above threshold.
sre-oncall: will set alert runbook. What about cache warming / KV cache drop when switching variants? We might see a burst of latency.
sophia: good call — add a KV cache warmup task for common prefixes and keep canary small to avoid global cache churn. Also enable prefix caching for top routes.
mike: make sure the catalog exposes a 'pin' flag so support can force pin for any org for the next 24h.
sophia: implemented in the rollout PR (link: https://git.internal/redwood/catalog/pull/512).
amelia: release notes draft in PR: short summary, rollback conditions, pinned org list, fallback ordering, and perf numbers from offline evals.
ryan: can we include a smoke test checklist that SRE runs before each step? quick list: 1) synthetic load for 1m; 2) hit p95 < 1.5x baseline; 3) error rate < 0.1%; 4) model outputs sanity check for 50 prompts.
sre-oncall: acknowledged. I'll post runbook with run commands.
deploy-bot: rel_2026_04_strix_v2_01 status -> queued -> awaiting change window.
amelia: final ask: keep communications in this thread during the window. Tag @sre-oncall and @support for any rollback requests. :thumbsup:
ryan: noted. I'll be watching dashboard and will call rollback if triggers fire.
sophia: thanks everyone — deploying canary at 22:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: rel_2026_04_strix_v2_01 triggered -> canary-started (5% traffic). Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/rel_2026_04_strix_v2_01/logs
sre-oncall: initial smoke tests running. No immediate regressions in first 3 minutes.
julian: good. Keep an eye on kv-cache miss rate.
sophia: seeing small bump in kv-misses, expected. warming job kicked off.
ora: enterprise pin applied to orgs in the list.
amelia: thanks team — will update release notes post-window and close thread after 24h stable.
deploy-bot: rel_2026_04_strix_v2_01 milestone -> staged-25pct at 2026-04-02T22:30:00Z
deploy-bot: rel_2026_04_strix_v2_01 milestone -> rollback-triggered at 2026-04-02T23:05:12Z (manual rollback requested by ryan).
amelia: rollback initiated. Reason: p95 latency increased ~40% for 15m on several routes despite warmup. Rolling back to strix-v1.
sophia: diagnostic note — seems q8 path overheated on several GPU types; opening issue to add rate-limiting on heavy decodes.
deploy-bot: rel_2026_04_strix_v2_01 status -> rolled-back -> traffic restored to strix-v1.
sre-oncall: rollback completed and health checks passing.
ryan: thanks for quick action. We'll delay next attempt until quantization and kernel changes land.
amelia: logged postmortem action items in the release ticket. Will publish a short internal note tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
